effects.name: state-format-6
effects.detail: every snapshot write uses state format 6, whose units carry previous_acceptance_pack_digest and refreeze_green_required; a format-5 store is refused until upgrade rewrites it, adding both fields as empty and false without changing its revision or evidence

effects.name: respecify-previous-digest
effects.system: the project's Vouch store (its event log)
effects.detail: a new UnitRespecified event records, as previous_pack_digest, the inventory digest the respecify clears (or the one already retained); an older event without the field decodes as empty and sets no fresh-GREEN requirement
